models.name: structured_no_notes_baseline
models.label: Structured no-notes modality ablation
models.conditions: Conditional comparator only: use to quantify performance when clinical notes are unavailable, not as a preferred standalone deployment model. Any deployment must audit orthopaedic, low-SOFA, and elective-admission sensitivity.
models.narrative: Structured no-notes modality ablation trained the same calibrated elastic-net logistic architecture as the clinical baseline but excluded has_notes, note_risk_score_imputed, and note_risk_score_missing. On held-out test data, AUROC was 0.743, AUPRC 0.698, sensitivity 0.783, and Brier score 0.198. The result supports modality comparison against note-aware and MoE models rather than replacing them.

deployment_questions.q1_miss_rate: At threshold 0.3050, the no-notes model missed 91 of 420 deteriorations on the held-out test set.
deployment_questions.q2_alert_precision: Alert precision (PPV) was 0.539; 610 test patients were flagged.
deployment_questions.q3_clearance_safety: NPV was 0.767. A low no-notes risk score should not clear a patient without standard bedside monitoring because the notes modality was intentionally unavailable.
deployment_questions.q4_discrimination: AUROC was 0.743 and AUPRC was 0.698. Largest observed subgroup sensitivity gap was -0.533 in surgery_type=orthopaedic.
deployment_questions.q5_calibration: Calibrated Brier score was 0.198. Probabilities are calibrated on the validation split and should be rechecked prospectively if notes are absent in a new ward workflow.

failure_analysis.who_is_missed: Misses concentrate most in surgery_type=orthopaedic (sensitivity 0.250, n=250, positives=60).
failure_analysis.false_alarm_profile: The threshold produced 281 false positives and specificity 0.516; alert burden is similar to the note-aware structured baseline but without note context.
failure_analysis.feature_importance_interpretation: Top positive coefficients without notes: admission_urgency_emergency (1.042), surgery_type_cardiac (0.748), sofa_score (0.302), age (0.119), icu_creatinine (0.116). Top negative coefficients: surgery_type_orthopaedic (-0.258), surgery_type_vascular (-0.128), sex_M (-0.089), spo2_mean (-0.083), sbp_mean (-0.062).
failure_analysis.model_disagreement: This model is the planned notes-modality ablation: compare it with clinical_elastic_net_baseline and data_availability_moe to isolate the incremental evidence carried by note-risk and NLP features.

models.name: clinical_elastic_net_baseline
models.label: Clinical elastic-net logistic baseline
models.conditions: Conditional baseline only: use as the minimum explainable comparator, not as standalone clinical automation. Keep icu_hours excluded from deployable use, validate calibration prospectively, and audit subgroup sensitivity before any escalation workflow.
models.narrative: Clinical elastic-net logistic regression trained on structured, interpretable features for deteriorated_24h. On held-out test data, calibrated AUROC was 0.743, AUPRC 0.697, sensitivity 0.790, and Brier score 0.198. Raw AUROC was 0.743; calibrated probabilities are the reported risk output.

deployment_questions.q1_miss_rate: At threshold 0.3011, the model missed 88 of 420 deteriorations on the held-out test set.
deployment_questions.q2_alert_precision: Alert precision (PPV) was 0.539; 616 test patients were flagged.
deployment_questions.q3_clearance_safety: NPV was 0.771. Low-risk clearance should retain standard ICU safety-net monitoring because false negatives remain.
deployment_questions.q4_discrimination: Calibrated AUROC was 0.743 and AUPRC was 0.697. Largest observed subgroup sensitivity gap was -0.524 in surgery_type=orthopaedic.
deployment_questions.q5_calibration: Calibrated Brier score was 0.198. Use calibrated probabilities for prioritisation; raw probabilities are retained only for comparison.

failure_analysis.who_is_missed: Misses concentrate most in surgery_type=orthopaedic (sensitivity 0.267, n=250, positives=60).
failure_analysis.false_alarm_profile: The selected threshold produced 284 false positives and specificity 0.510; alert burden should be reviewed before operational use.
failure_analysis.feature_importance_interpretation: Top positive coefficients: admission_urgency_emergency (1.041), surgery_type_cardiac (0.751), sofa_score (0.299), age (0.117), icu_creatinine (0.111). Top negative coefficients: surgery_type_orthopaedic (-0.232), spo2_mean (-0.079), sex_M (-0.076), surgery_type_vascular (-0.073), sbp_mean (-0.060).
failure_analysis.model_disagreement: Use structured_no_notes_baseline as the notes-modality ablation and data_availability_moe as the dynamic multimodal comparator. The icu_hours sensitivity check remains non-deployable; AUROC delta +0.000.

models.name: data_availability_moe
models.label: Data-availability MoE with dynamic belief update
models.conditions: Conditional retrospective simulation only. Validate prospectively before use, treat t24 as full-information reference rather than clean prospective prediction, and audit no-notes, surgical, and high-uncertainty subgroups.
models.narrative: Data-availability MoE trained three shallow LightGBM experts: structured fallback, with-notes, and no-notes MNAR-context. At t24 on held-out test data, calibrated belief AUROC was 0.859, AUPRC 0.813, sensitivity 0.705, and Brier 0.151. Validation selected lambda_with=0.0 and lambda_no=0.0.

deployment_questions.q1_miss_rate: At threshold 0.4963, the t24 belief model missed 124 of 420 held-out deteriorations.
deployment_questions.q2_alert_precision: PPV was 0.769; alert count was 411 at t24.
deployment_questions.q3_clearance_safety: NPV was 0.798. Low-risk outputs with high uncertainty are routed to manual review rather than safe all-clear.
deployment_questions.q4_discrimination: t24 AUROC was 0.859 and AUPRC was 0.813. Largest primary subgroup sensitivity gap was -0.455 in surgery_type=orthopaedic.
deployment_questions.q5_calibration: t24 Brier score was 0.151. MoE outputs use route-specific Platt calibration before belief updating.

failure_analysis.who_is_missed: Most adverse primary subgroup gap: surgery_type=orthopaedic with sensitivity 0.250, n=250, positives=60.
failure_analysis.false_alarm_profile: At t24 the model produced 89 false positives and specificity 0.847.
failure_analysis.feature_importance_interpretation: Route-level interpretation remains primary: E0 is the structured fallback, E1 adds note risk and auxiliary NLP indicators when notes exist, and E2 handles the no-notes MNAR route. Feature attribution adds a ranked evidence view: top final-risk drivers are Lactate slope, SpO2 minimum, Admission urgency, SOFA score, Respiratory rate variability. Within the with-notes expert, top drivers are Lactate slope, Note text risk score, SpO2 minimum; within the no-notes expert, top drivers are Lactate slope, SpO2 minimum, Respiratory rate variability. The local counterfactual example is patient P1836 (high_risk_false_positive), where Respiratory rate mean contributes 0.027 risk versus baseline.
failure_analysis.model_disagreement: no_notes: AUROC 0.858, Brier 0.156, sensitivity 0.800, n=336; with_notes: AUROC 0.851, Brier 0.148, sensitivity 0.633, n=664

option_specific.title: Clinical AI readiness decision support rubric

per_model.thresholds_applied: Calibrated t24 MoE threshold 0.4963 with route-specific Platt calibration, dynamic belief update, and high-uncertainty senior/manual review routing.
per_model.evidence_summary: CONDITIONAL retrospective prototype. Test t24 AUROC 0.8594, sensitivity 0.7048, specificity 0.8466, PPV 0.7688, NPV 0.7984. Stronger discrimination and lower false-alarm burden than baselines, but it misses 124/420 deteriorations and t24 is not a clean prospective prediction setting.

content.readiness_decision: Conditional retrospective decision-support prototype; require prospective validation and subgroup monitoring before deployment.

explainability.description: The MoE reports route, E0/E1/E2 predictions, expert disagreement, bootstrap risk interval, data uncertainty, entropy, belief updates, and recommended action. Additional feature attribution evidence is stored under artifacts/data_availability_moe/feature_attribution/: global final-risk permutation importance, route-expert permutation importance, partial effects, and a local counterfactual case. The top final-risk feature is Lactate slope (mean AUROC drop 0.102; mean Brier increase 0.046). The attribution refit used the same split and feature pipeline with HistGradientBoostingClassifier because the saved LightGBM artifact could not be safely unpickled in this environment; its AUROC 0.868 is close to the original MoE reference AUROC 0.859.

overall_notes: Clinical AI Readiness Decision Support submission for team trusta. The evidence compares three ICU deterioration approaches: a structured no-notes ablation, a note-aware interpretable elastic-net baseline, and a data-availability MoE with dynamic vitals, notes routing, and uncertainty outputs. All three are CONDITIONAL because the evidence shows useful risk ranking but persistent orthopaedic/elective false-negative risk and the MoE t24 result is a retrospective full-information reference rather than a clean prospective deployment result.
